text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The Circular Urban Economies Transition Pathway (CUE) wants to foster the design of urban places characterized by regenerative urbanism, by which we mean liveable, inclusive, and green communities and neighbourhoods that are sustained by circular urban economies and resource flows.", "gist": "CUE aims to promote urban design based on regenerative urbanism for liveable, inclusive, and green communities supported by circular economies."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Swiss Federal Office of Energy (SFOE)", "gist": "Swiss Federal Office of Energy"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Innosuisse", "gist": "Innosuisse"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Swiss Science National Foundation (SNSF)", "gist": "Swiss Science National Foundation"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal of Civil Aviation (FOCA)", "gist": "Federal Office of Civil Aviation"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "DUT", "gist": "DUT programme"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Swiss based applicants can join research consortia on equal terms with applicants from EU Member States and other Associated Partners.", "gist": "Swiss applicants can join research consortia equally with EU and other partners"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "1st September", "gist": "1st September 2023"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The second DUT call has been launched on 1st September.", "gist": "The second DUT call was launched on 1st September."}]}
